summary: Bravo Multinational Inc., a Wyoming media and amusement company listed OTC (formerly GoldLand Holdings), issued 1,621,026 shares of Series A Preferred Stock to MWP Entertainment Group LLC under a Share Purchase Agreement dated September 18, 2026. Total consideration of $3,161,000 comprises $2,500,000 in perpetual content and software licenses, a $400,000 cash investment due by October 5, 2026, and forgiveness of $261,000 in loans. Preferred shares are convertible into 100 common shares each, priced off a $0.0195 10-day VWAP. Control and board composition changed, with new officers appointed. Closing occurred simultaneously with execution.
